Hi Olga / Laura —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to establish a concrete mutual timeline so our procurement and legal teams can coordinate the evaluation window, security review, and signature path. Attached is a draft MAP (MedArc_MAP_v1.pdf) showing our preferred milestones.

High-level asks from our side:
- 2-week eval window (start target: Jul 7)
- Security questionnaire and DPA sign-off before production data ingestion
- MSA redlines consolidated into a single doc for faster review (we'll circulate internal comments)

Could Redwood put together a Gantt-style sequencing that shows: evaluation milestones, security evidence handoff dates, MSA/DPA review lanes, and order form/PO timing? If we can see dependencies (e.g., DPA before PO, legal redlines before signature), we'll be able to map internal approvers on our side.

Proposed meeting: Wed Jun 18, 11:00 AM PT — 30 minutes to agree owners and deadlines. Does that work?

Claire

Claire / Olga —

Quick note on acceptance criteria and evidence windows so sequencing is actionable:
- Eval acceptance: 3 representative flows (search, generate, embed) validated against provided test prompts by MedArc CS lead by day 10 of eval
- Quality regression threshold: any model response fallback >10% triggers a short remediation sprint (2 business days) and potential extension of eval window
- Security evidence: SOC2 report + network diagram + data retention table required for on-boarding. We can provide anonymized sample logs for your review by day 3 of eval.

On the legal side, if MedArc can provide consolidated redlines in a single Word doc by Jun 24 we will prioritize a focused review and return a reconciled draft by Jun 30 (internal legal SLA 4 business days). That should enable a Jul 10 signature target if both teams move quickly; otherwise Jul 24 is our conservative fallback after signing post-eval.

I'll prepare the Gantt and include explicit fallback paths (canary in lower envs, temporary data isolation) in case legal lags.

Laura
VP, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Cho <ben.cho@medarc.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, claire.sanders@medarc.com
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -07:00

Thanks all — quick procurement perspective: two items to reflect in the sequencing Gantt:
1) Internal PO approvals: we need legal signature + security sign-off before procurement issues a PO. That typically adds 3 business days for our AP/finance queue.
2) Budget quarter cutoff: if signature occurs after Jul 15 we'll need to route through next quarter's budget and that will delay PO by ~3 weeks.

If Redwood can show a path that keeps signature <= Jul 15, procurement will prioritize issuing PO in the current quarter. Otherwise we'll need a contingency acceptance window and a temporary engineering allocation hold.

Ben Cho
Sr. Procurement Analyst | MedArc Health

- Eval start: target Jul 7 (2-week window). MedArc to provide test prompts and security questionnaire answers by Jul 1.
- Legal cadence: MedArc to return consolidated redlines by Jun 24. Redwood legal will reconcile and return by Jun 30. Final sign target Jul 10 (preferred) / Jul 24 (fallback).
- Procurement: PO issuance dependent on signature + security sign-off; Ben to expedite if signature <= Jul 15.
- Technical handoffs: Redwood infra to provision dev cluster within 48 hours of PO clearance; canary in lower envs first.

- Claire (MedArc): consolidated redlines doc — due Jun 24.
- MedArc Procurement (Ben): confirm internal PO checklist and notify if any additional evidence required — due Jun 20.
- Olga (Redwood): produce Gantt with swimlanes and a milestone table showing dependencies + two fallback timelines (fast: Jul 10 sign; conservative: Jul 24 sign) — due Jun 19 EOD. (Attachment: Redwood_Sequencing_Gantt_v1.pdf)
- Laura (Redwood): prepare acceptance checklist and evidence pack itemization — due Jun 22.
- Karthik (Redwood legal): ready reconciled MSA draft by Jun 30 after receiving redlines.

Risks called out:
- If MedArc's consolidated redlines slip past Jun 24, legal reconciliation could push sign past the Jul 15 quarter cutoff and delay PO issuance.
- Security questionnaire delays will block provisioning and PO clearance.

Next meeting: quick 20-min checkpoint Tue Jun 24, 9:00 AM PT (to confirm redlines received and legal timing).

Thanks — I'll circulate the Gantt and milestone table now.
